# saige: Super Artificial Intelligence Graph Environment

> A Go SDK and CLI for building AI agents, giving them context and memory, and evaluating them.

Combines three packages: agent (streaming AI agent loop with typed deltas, tool dispatch, sub-agents, human-in-the-loop markers, structured output, provider resilience via retry/fallback, conversation tree with branching and compaction, and RLHF feedback), knowledge (LLM-powered knowledge graph construction with PostgreSQL + pgvector and hybrid search), and rag (multi-modal RAG pipelines with chunking, multi-retriever fusion, reranking, HyDE query transformation, and citations). Includes research tools (web search via SearXNG, file search/read, knowledge graph CRUD), opt-in tool packs (workspace files with root confinement, a sandboxed bash tool with command/env/network policy, and a URL fetch tool that blocks private and metadata addresses; mutating tools always require approval) and an MCP server binary (`saige-mcp`) that exposes tool packs over stdio for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and other MCP clients. Includes a universal evaluation framework with built-in scorers for text quality, agent performance, RAG relevance, and knowledge graph extraction. Ships a CLI (`saige`) with interactive chat, single-shot queries, an HTTP + SSE server (`saige serve`) with approve and cancel endpoints, and standalone RAG/KG operations.

- [agent/README.md](agent/README.md): Agent framework: providers, deltas, tools, sub-agents, markers, conversation tree, RLHF feedback, TUI, testing

- [rag/README.md](rag/README.md): RAG pipelines: data model, chunking, retrieval, reranking, HyDE, metrics, tool bindings
- [eval/README.md](eval/README.md): Evaluation framework: scorers, A/B experiments, LLM-as-judge, stream timing
- [cmd/saige/README.md](cmd/saige/README.md): CLI reference: chat, ask, serve, rag, kg
- [cmd/saige-mcp/README.md](cmd/saige-mcp/README.md): MCP server setup for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI
- [docs/catalog.md](docs/catalog.md): Model catalog and presets: JSON schema, sources and layers, merge rules, precedence, validation, preset building, CLI
- [docs/mcp-client.md](docs/mcp-client.md): MCP client: pooled sessions, retries, drift detection, config loading
- [docs/observability.md](docs/observability.md): OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics: span tree, usage, routing, error kinds, redaction
- [tools/research/README.md](tools/research/README.md): Research tools: web search, file ops, knowledge graph CRUD
- [tools/fs/README.md](tools/fs/README.md): Workspace file tools: read with paging, glob, grep, write, edit; read-only by default
- [tools/exec/README.md](tools/exec/README.md): Sandboxed bash tool: Sandbox interface, subprocess backend, command/env/network policy
- [tools/fetch/README.md](tools/fetch/README.md): URL fetch tool and SafeHTTPClient
- [examples/README.md](examples/README.md): Runnable example index

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, commit conventions
